name: Retina Revealed
description: Everything posterior segment — optic disc, macula, OCT interpretation, diabetic retinopathy, AMD, vascular occlusions, peripheral pathology, and detachments.

episodes.title: Anatomy of the Posterior Pole: From Bruch’s to Photoreceptors
episodes.description: A layered tour of the retina that makes every future OCT and fundus finding click into place.

episodes.title: The Optic Disc: Cup, Rim, and the ISNT Rule
episodes.description: Reading neuroretinal rim symmetry and recognizing the earliest glaucomatous and pathological changes.

episodes.title: Macula and Fovea: The High-Resolution Zone
episodes.description: Locating the fovea, reading the foveal reflex, and spotting the subtle distortions of early disease.

episodes.title: Retinal Vasculature: Arteries, Veins, and the AV Crossing
episodes.description: Distinguishing arteries from veins, grading AV nicking, and recognizing hypertensive and arteriolar changes.

episodes.title: OCT Macula: Reading the Nine Layers on a Single Scan
episodes.description: A reproducible method for interpreting macular OCT — identifying fluid, drusen, and atrophy in seconds.

episodes.title: OCT RNFL: The Glaucoma Surveillance Workhorse
episodes.description: Reading thickness maps, quadrant asymmetry, and progression — and knowing when the printout lies.

episodes.title: Fundus Photography: Composing a Diagnostic Image
episodes.description: Field definitions, stereo pairs, and the montage that captures the peripheral pathology a single frame misses.

episodes.title: Fundus Autofluorescence: Lipofuscin as a Disease Marker
episodes.description: Reading hypo- and hyper-autofluorescent patterns in Stargardt, AMD, and hydroxychloroquine toxicity.

episodes.title: Fluorescein Angiography: Phases, Leakage, and Blocking
episodes.description: Interpreting the arterial, venous, and late phases — and distinguishing leakage from window defects.

episodes.title: ICG Angiography: Seeing Choroidal Lesions Fluorescein Misses
episodes.description: When to reach for ICG — occult CNV, polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy, and choroidal tumors.

episodes.title: Diabetic Retinopathy: Staging from Mild NPDR to PDR
episodes.description: The ETDRS-derived severity scale, what each stage looks like at the slit lamp, and what it means for the patient.

episodes.title: Diabetic Macular Edema: CSME Criteria and Anti-VEGF Thresholds
episodes.description: Recognizing clinically significant macular edema and the OCT features that trigger treatment.

episodes.title: Panretinal Photocoagulation: What the Optometrist Must Know
episodes.description: Understanding PRP indications, post-laser appearance, and the visual side effects your patient will describe.

episodes.title: Dry AMD: Drusen, Pigment, and the AREDS2 Decision
episodes.description: Classifying drusen, stratifying risk, and counseling on supplements, diet, and Amsler monitoring.

episodes.title: Wet AMD: Recognizing the Conversion Before Vision is Lost
episodes.description: Subretinal fluid, hemorrhage, and PED — the OCT and clinical signs that demand urgent anti-VEGF.
